Chapter 218: Chapter 14 Beating Wanyang Holy Son (Subscribe Please)_2

This is completely a losing trade.

Of course, even for human civilization, “resurrecting” an evolver is a huge burden to bear.

Many Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank evolvers, even if they could be “resurrected,” would not be “resurrected.”

…

“A few days before the Red Spirit Fluid arrives, I can finish off the remaining challenge applications…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the many evolvers he had applied to battle in the arena area.

...

Since there was nothing else to do now, battling these genius evolvers from the human territories was also a gain.

Especially the Wanyang Holy Son, who had defeated him once before; just a few days later, Lin Yuan had applied again, and his opponent had agreed.

…..

The next day.

It was still the same time.

Around the arena where Lin Yuan was about to appear, a large audience gathered.

“Why is this Peak Master Thirteen sparring with the Wanyang Holy Son again?”

“Didn’t they just fight recently? There’s a big difference in their strength.”

“Right, could it be that Peak Master Thirteen likes being dominated?”

…

Around the arena, numerous spectators were discussing animatedly.

Although they enjoyed watching Peak Master Thirteen’s matches, they wanted to see him crush and dominate his opponents.

Not to be crushed and dominated.

Especially for some spectators from the Chikun Star Domain, some couldn’t bear to keep watching.

Watching their ‘idol’ being incinerated into nothingness by the Wanyang Holy Son was torturous.

“Hahaha, go Holy Son, keep crushing your opponent.”

“Just an underling, not a match for our Holy Son’s single strike.”

“People of the Chikun Star Domain, listen up, you’re about to see our Holy Son crush everything with his strength…”

Compared to the subdued atmosphere of the Chikun Star Domain audience, the spectators from the Wanyang Star Domain were extremely excited.

No matter what, Peak Master Thirteen holds a high status in the Chikun Star Domain, and losing to the Wanyang Holy Son once was a sight worth seeing; losing again would still be a pleasing thing.

“What’s there to be proud of?”

“People from the Wanyang Star Domain really have no manners.”

“The Wanyang Holy Son is strong, but Peak Master Thirteen isn’t weak either, is there a need to say it like that?”

The audience from the Chikun Star Domain felt suppressed, but they didn’t know how to respond since strength was the basis of everything. The previous battle between Peak Master Thirteen and the Wanyang Holy Son indeed showed the latter as superior.

This fact hadn’t changed, so they didn’t know how to counter the taunts from the Wanyang Star Domain audience, it felt like being a class below.

…

Eastern side of the arena.

Lin Yi and a few friends sat together, waiting for the match to start.

“My brother stood me up again.”

Lin Yi looked around and realizing that Lin Yuan still hadn’t shown up, her expression immediately fell.

“Yiyi, I heard your brother is also an evolutionary genius who has won championships in your planet’s arena contests,” asked a girl with twin ponytails sitting next to Lin Yi, who was curious.

She came from another planet and had met Lin Yi in the virtual world.

“That’s right.”

Upon hearing this, a proud expression appeared on Lin Yi’s face.

She glanced at the arena below, thinking about Peak Master Thirteen who was about to appear, and shook her head, “But compared to Peak Master Thirteen, my brother is far behind.”

Not only far behind, but he also didn’t even want to come and watch to learn… Lin Yi felt annoyed, thinking that Lin Yuan was again gathering with some friends.

“There aren’t many evolvers who can compare to Peak Master Thirteen.”

Another friend commented, clearly very admiring of Peak Master Thirteen.

…

Arena.

This time, the simulated environment was a desolate planet, many times larger than Canglan Star, sufficient for two Fifth Rank peak evolvers to clash.

Woosh.

Lin Yuan appeared on the top of a mountain.

Shortly after.

On another mountain top in the distance, the Wanyang Holy Son appeared.

The Wanyang Holy Son had a calm expression, his aura was soothing and warm.

“Peak Master Thirteen.”

The Wanyang Holy Son looked towards the distant Lin Yuan, inevitably puzzled.

Not long ago, this Peak Master Thirteen had fought with him, surely realizing the disparity between their strength, why did he still intend to challenge him?

It must be known… the stronger ones are, the more they care about losing face, losing to the Wanyang Holy Son once wasn’t enough, he wanted to lose twice?

“Does Peak Master Thirteen, after every battle, grow stronger? Could it be he sees me as a whetstone?”

A smile appeared on the Wanyang Holy Son’s face.

A whetstone? That’s when the strengths are similar or nearly so.

If he fully exerted himself, ending the fight in the shortest time, what honing effect could it possibly have?

A few minutes later.

The match began.

Lin Yuan and the Wanyang Holy Son faced each other.

“Shisan Peak Master, you must be careful this time,”

Wanyang Holy Son’s thoughts stirred slightly, and a scorching aura began to spread.

“You too,”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly.

His figure then disappeared from the spot.

“Huh?”

Wanyang Holy Son was startled.

He couldn’t at all see when Lin Yuan had disappeared.

“How has the speed become so fast?”

Wanyang Holy Son’s face changed slightly.

At that moment, Wanyang Holy Son only faintly felt that Lin Yuan was still present in the arena, but he couldn’t pinpoint his exact location.

“Merely with speed, you can’t beat me,”

Wanyang Holy Son snorted coldly, instantly releasing his ‘Wanyang Domain.’

In an instant.

Centered around Wanyang Holy Son.

Within a radius of ten miles, a hundred miles, several hundred miles, everything was engulfed by terrifying heat.

“Wanyang… Same Heaven!!!”

Wanyang Holy Son transformed into an ‘incarnation’ of a ‘Permanent Star,’ constantly condensing into miniature stars within the range of his domain, releasing endless heat, and then exploding.

Since he couldn’t pin down Lin Yuan’s position, he decided to directly destroy an entire area.

After all, Lin Yuan must be in that area.

Buzz.

At that moment.

A figure appeared a kilometer away from Wanyang Holy Son.

It was Lin Yuan.

Facing the scorching heat and burning around him,

Lin Yuan showed no hint of retreat and extended his right hand to slap towards Wanyang Holy Son.

Boom.

Terrifying power enveloped his strike.

And it came into contact with the Wanyang Domain and the secret technique ‘Wanyang Same Heaven.’

But to Wanyang Holy Son’s disbelief, the force of that slap from Lin Yuan instantly penetrated the Wanyang Domain.

“This is bad,”

Wanyang Holy Son’s expression drastically changed, and he began to retreat explosively.

However, Lin Yuan took another step forward, appearing a hundred meters from Wanyang Holy Son, and slapped again.

Rumble.

The air tore apart; Lin Yuan’s attack was too ferocious. Although it was just a simple slap, it somehow enveloped the area all around, covering all positions, leaving Wanyang Holy Son with no place to hide.

Sss.

Wanyang Holy Son could only grit his teeth and take Lin Yuan’s slap head-on.

The next moment.

Wanyang Holy Son’s figure exploded.

Whooosh!!

Countless scorching flames converged.

A few miles away, Wanyang Holy Son’s form re-condensed.

“My Wanyang Immortal Body…”

Disbelief was written all over Wanyang Holy Son’s face. With the Nine Yang Divine Meridian and the truth crystal of myriad fire, combined with the infinite power from the depths of a star, Wanyang Holy Son cultivated the Wanyang Immortal Body.

The Wanyang Immortal Body allowed his physical body to energetically transform for a short period, similar to ‘Thunder God’s’ incarnation of thunder, but the Wanyang Immortal Body was even more profound and high-end.

It had the effect of acting as a substitute for death.

Without the Wanyang Immortal Body, Wanyang Holy Son would have died outright from that slap from Lin Yuan, shattered to pieces, with no chance of survival.

“I concede,”

Without hesitation, Wanyang Holy Son applied to concede, even though he wasn’t dead, and the Wanyang Immortal Body could still act as a substitute a few more times.

But having witnessed the terrifying strength exhibited by Lin Yuan, Wanyang Holy Son didn’t want to waste more time.

What could dragging it out with the Wanyang Immortal Body achieve? It would only result in taking a few more slaps, completely devoid of any dignity.

“You should be able to step into the Sixth Rank at any time,”

“We’ll meet again at the Sixth Rank,”

Wanyang Holy Son took a deep look at Lin Yuan, then vanished.

The gap in strength between Lin Yuan then and now was too great; the only possibility was that his soul had transformed to perfection.

“Did I win just like that?”

Lin Yuan also felt that he won too easily, with the Martial Path Evolutionary Path as the core evolutionary path, achieving 100% transformation compatibility with his soul, which had greatly enhanced his strength.

“What’s going on?”

Lin Yuan looked around.

He noticed that all around him had quietened down.

In the tournament stadium, countless spectators, whether they were from Chikun Star Domain, Wanyang Star Domain, or from other ‘neutral’ star domains,

were all dumbstruck, mouths agape.
